title: 37463 跟进：服务器 5xx 故障日志不打印被包装的原始错误（cause）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbeF2saT6wUBV4E9uc

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37463. The source is the os-dev rework report on PR #37550 (comment 7195114149, out-of-scope finding, class a). The owning area files it under the source card, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · Bug · p2 · reach: every operator reading a 5xx fault line from a producer that wraps a driver error on `cause` (record-context outages on both MCP doors; any other wrapper) · evidence: measured (real-kernel harness, `packages/runtime/src/mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts`, before PR #37550's stack suffix).

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：服务器记录 5xx 故障日志时，只打印外层错误的信息和堆栈，不打印它包着的原始错误（`cause`）。运维看日志时找不到真正的故障原因。让故障日志把原始错误一起打出来。
- 谁受益：排障的运维和开发。
- 不做会怎样：每个把底层错误包一层再抛出的地方，日志里都丢了根因；各处只能各自把原因拼进堆栈来绕开。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
- `packages/types/src/server-fault-log.ts#logServerFault` prints `console.error(message, { ...meta, stack })` and `logger.error(message, err, meta)`.
- `packages/core/src/logger.ts` `write()` serializes an error as `{ message, stack }`.
- Neither reads `Error.cause`, so a 5xx thrown with the original on `cause` logs without it. PR #37550 worked around this for record-context by appending `Caused by:` and the original's stack to the failure's own stack.
1. Print the `cause` chain in both sinks: message and stack of each cause, bounded in depth, and never on the wire (the fault log is operator-only).
2. Then drop the record-context stack suffix of PR #37550, so there is one place that renders a cause.

## Acceptance
- A test per sink: a 5xx with a nested `cause` logs each cause's message and stack; a cycle or a deep chain is bounded.
- The record-context harness outage case still finds the original in the fault line after the suffix is removed.
- No change to any response body.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Size: S
